answer_1.quote: Compared with document summarization, dialogue summarization aims at generating condensed text from the dialogue contexts among multiple speakers... In this paper, we propose a new model, namely ReWriteSum, to tackle this problem.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate our models, we utilize both quantitative metrics and human evaluation... we use ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L as quantitative metrics.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we randomly select 100 dialogue-summary pairs... Five annotators (all CS majored students studying NLP) are demanded to give the comparison... They are required to evaluate the generated summary from three aspects: whether the generation is fluent, whether it has omitted content, and whether it has factual inconsistent errors.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate each generated summary on three criteria: fluency, omitted content, and factual inconsistency.
